narrative:
Darke County has 33,973 registered voters, with 53.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 7.9%, a pronounced Republican lean of 30.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.2% of registrants.
